sources.entry: Lunar - Intelligent adaptive brightness for your external displays.

summary.one_liner: Lunar is a macOS app for controlling external monitors' brightness, volume, contrast and inputs, using DDC/CI hardware control plus adaptive brightness options.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes a macOS app that changes the hardware brightness of external monitors over the DDC/CI protocol, falling back to a software overlay only when DDC/CI is not supported. It offers keyboard hotkeys for brightness, volume and contrast that respect per-monitor min/max limits, and can dim below 0%. Adaptive brightness and contrast can be driven by an external light sensor, by the MacBook or iMac built-in sensor, or by sunrise/sunset times at your location. Other features include app presets, input switching via dropdown or hotkeys, screen rotation hotkeys, hidden resolutions, and BlackOut, which turns off selected displays while keeping USB-C charging, monitor audio, USB hub and built-in keyboard/trackpad working. The README says it does not interfere with macOS's built-in adaptive brightness for the built-in display and works alongside Night Shift and True Tone.
use_cases: control external monitor brightness from a Mac
automatically adjust monitor brightness by time of day or ambient light
adjust external monitor volume and contrast with keyboard shortcuts
turn off a monitor while keeping USB-C charging and hub working
rotate a display from the menu bar
notable: Changes hardware brightness via DDC/CI rather than a software overlay when the monitor supports it
Adaptive brightness from an external sensor, the built-in MacBook/iMac sensor, or sunrise/sunset location
BlackOut mode turns off displays while keeping charging, audio, USB hub and built-in input working
Supports native Intel and Apple Silicon Macs
caveats: Some features are paid (Pro); the README says the paid-feature source code is encrypted and the repo cannot be built from source
Contributions are paused according to the README
Works only with monitors and connections that support DDC/CI or forward DDC messages; adapters vary
